description: This file contains source code related to shape operations, tensor shape validation, and tensor concatenation optimizations specifically for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS). It includes utility functions for shape manipulation, shape checks, and kernel launches for tensor concatenation on MPS devices, as well as a top-k operation implementation utilizing MPSGraph for computation.

methods.name: getTopK0Shape
methods.description: Generates a shape vector for top-k operations with the specified dimension set to zero.

methods.name: check_shape_except_dim
methods.description: Validates that two tensors have matching shapes except along a specified dimension.

methods.name: get_type_str
methods.description: Template specializations returning the string representation of a given type.

methods.name: cat_out_mps_contiguous_impl
methods.description: Concatenates tensors assumed to be contiguous with same dtype along dimension 0 by directly copying buffers.

methods.name: cat_out_mps_impl
methods.description: Concatenates tensors along a specified dimension, dispatching to either int32 or int64 implementation based on tensor properties.
